de5da2eec81b.en: In 1945 the economist George Stigler asked what it costs, at the least, to feed a person for a year. He had seventy-seven foods and nine nutrients, and a person needs enough of each. <bookmark mark='a'/> By trial and insight he found a diet costing thirty-nine dollars and ninety-three cents a year, at 1939 prices, mostly wheat flour, cabbage and evaporated milk. He wrote that there was no direct way to find the true minimum. <bookmark mark='b'/> Two years later George Dantzig invented one. Jack Laderman's team worked his simplex method by hand on desk calculators, <bookmark mark='c'/> roughly a hundred and twenty person-days of arithmetic, and found thirty-nine sixty-nine. And it came with something Stigler could not have: a proof that no diet is cheaper. <bookmark mark='d'/> That proof, which this part calls duality, is the idea that lasts.
de5da2eec81b.zh: 1945年，经济学家 George Stigler 问：养活一个人一年，最少要花多少钱？他有七十七种食物和九种营养素，一个人每种营养都要摄入足够。<bookmark mark='a'/>凭着试算和洞察，他找到一份每年三十九美元九十三美分的食谱，按1939年的价格计，主要是小麦粉、卷心菜和炼乳。他写道，没有直接的办法找到真正的最小值。<bookmark mark='b'/>两年后，George Dantzig 发明了这样的办法。Jack Laderman 的团队用台式计算器，手工执行他的单纯形法，<bookmark mark='c'/>大约花了一百二十个人日的算术，得到三十九美元六十九美分。而且它带来了 Stigler 不可能有的东西：一个证明，证明没有更便宜的食谱。<bookmark mark='d'/>这个证明，这一部分称之为对偶，才是经久不衰的思想。

a6f1da4358d4.en: This part is about choosing the best, and about the three kinds of answer we can get. <bookmark mark='a'/> For linear programs, the best point of a polytope, there are fast algorithms and exact answers that come with a proof. <bookmark mark='b'/> For problems with integer choices, like the travelling salesman, the exact answer is NP-hard; we settle for algorithms with proven guarantees, and heuristics that do better than the guarantees promise. <bookmark mark='c'/> And for decisions made without seeing the future, like which page to evict from a cache, we measure ourselves against a clairvoyant who sees everything, and prove we are never too far behind.
a6f1da4358d4.zh: 这一部分讲的是如何选出最好的，以及我们能得到的三种答案。<bookmark mark='a'/>对线性规划，也就是多面体上的最优点，有快速的算法，以及附带证明的精确答案。<bookmark mark='b'/>对带整数选择的问题，比如旅行商问题，求精确答案是 NP 难的；我们退而求其次，用有保证的算法，以及比保证承诺的做得更好的启发式方法。<bookmark mark='c'/>而对看不见未来就要做出的决定，比如缓存该淘汰哪一页，我们拿自己和一位什么都看得见的先知比较，并证明自己永远不会落后太多。

b042c746cdc1.en: Part 23 of Computer Science, Built: Optimization. <bookmark mark='a'/> In this part: linear programs, the simplex method and duality; why simplex is exponential in theory and fast in practice, and the polynomial methods that came after it; integer programs and when they are easy; approximation algorithms for covers, the travelling salesman, knapsack and MAX-CUT; online algorithms and multiplicative weights; and convex optimization in a page.
b042c746cdc1.zh: 计算机科学，从零搭建，第23部分：优化。<bookmark mark='a'/>这一部分包括：线性规划、单纯形法与对偶；为什么单纯形法在理论上是指数的、在实践中却很快，以及在它之后出现的多项式方法；整数规划，以及它何时是容易的；覆盖问题、旅行商问题、背包问题和最大割的近似算法；在线算法与乘性权重；以及一页纸讲完的凸优化。

9b31812b1383.en: A linear program asks for the largest value of a linear function, subject to linear inequalities. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is a small one, the first example in Vašek Chvátal's textbook: three products with profits five, four and three, made from three scarce resources, with the amounts each product needs on the left and the supply on the right. <bookmark mark='b'/> In matrix form: maximize c transpose x subject to A x at most b, with x non-negative. <bookmark mark='c'/> Leonid Kantorovich formulated such problems in 1939 to plan a plywood trust in Leningrad. <bookmark mark='d'/> George Dantzig met them in 1947, scheduling for the US Air Force, when programming still meant planning. <bookmark mark='e'/> Kantorovich and Tjalling Koopmans shared the 1975 Nobel prize in economics for this work; Dantzig, famously, did not.
9b31812b1383.zh: 线性规划要求在一组线性不等式的约束下，求一个线性函数的最大值。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是一个小例子，Vašek Chvátal 教科书中的第一个例子：三种产品，利润分别是五、四、三，用三种稀缺资源制成；左边是每种产品所需的资源量，右边是供应量。<bookmark mark='b'/>写成矩阵形式：在 A x 不超过 b、x 非负的条件下，最大化 c 转置 x。<bookmark mark='c'/>Leonid Kantorovich 在1939年为列宁格勒的一家胶合板托拉斯制定计划时，提出了这类问题。<bookmark mark='d'/>George Dantzig 在1947年为美国空军做调度时遇到了它们，那时“规划”这个词还只是“计划”的意思。<bookmark mark='e'/>Kantorovich 和 Tjalling Koopmans 因这项工作分享了1975年的诺贝尔经济学奖；众所周知，Dantzig 没有得奖。

1781c0236cb2.en: Most of the work of linear programming is modelling: deciding what the variables are. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is the kind of problem Kantorovich, and independently Frank Hitchcock in 1941, studied. Two plants make thirty and forty units; three stores need twenty, twenty-five and twenty-five; each road has a cost per unit shipped. <bookmark mark='b'/> Use one variable per road, the amount sent along it. <bookmark mark='c'/> Minimize the total cost, subject to each plant's capacity and each store's demand. <bookmark mark='d'/> Serving every store from its cheapest plant would cost three hundred and fifty-five dollars, but it asks plant B for fifty units, and B makes forty. <bookmark mark='e'/> The optimum costs three hundred and sixty-five: store three is split between the two plants, and ten units travel the more expensive road. <bookmark mark='f'/> A handful of tricks bring far more problems into this form. An equation is two inequalities. A variable that may be negative is the difference of two that may not. To minimize the largest of several linear costs, add a variable t, require each cost to be at most t, and minimize t. Absolute values work the same way. That is why so much of operations research is linear programming.
1781c0236cb2.zh: 线性规划的大部分工作在于建模：决定变量是什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是 Kantorovich，以及1941年独立地由 Frank Hitchcock 研究过的那类问题。两家工厂分别生产三十和四十个单位；三家商店分别需要二十、二十五和二十五；每条道路有每单位的运费。<bookmark mark='b'/>每条道路一个变量：沿它运送的数量。<bookmark mark='c'/>在每家工厂的产能和每家商店的需求约束下，最小化总费用。<bookmark mark='d'/>让每家商店都从最便宜的工厂进货，要花三百五十五美元，但这要求工厂 B 供应五十个单位，而 B 只能生产四十个。<bookmark mark='e'/>最优解花费三百六十五美元：商店三由两家工厂分担，有十个单位走了更贵的那条路。<bookmark mark='f'/>几个小技巧能把多得多的问题化成这种形式。一个等式就是两个不等式。可以为负的变量，是两个非负变量之差。要最小化几个线性费用中最大的那个，就添一个变量 t，要求每个费用都不超过 t，再最小化 t。绝对值也是同样的做法。这就是为什么运筹学中有那么多内容就是线性规划。

4ddc72823858.en: Each inequality cuts space in half, and the points satisfying all of them form a convex polytope. <bookmark mark='a'/> For our three products it is this solid in three dimensions, with the axes as three of its walls. <bookmark mark='b'/> It has six corners. <bookmark mark='c'/> The objective's level sets, the points with the same profit, are parallel planes. <bookmark mark='d'/> Push the plane in the direction of more profit until it is about to leave the polytope. The last point it touches is a corner: two units of the first product and one of the third, for a profit of thirteen. <bookmark mark='e'/> That is always so: a linear function on a polytope reaches its maximum at a vertex, so there are only finitely many places to look. The difficulty is that a polytope in many dimensions can have astronomically many vertices.
4ddc72823858.zh: 每个不等式把空间切成两半，满足所有不等式的点构成一个凸多面体。<bookmark mark='a'/>对我们的三种产品，它就是这个三维立体，坐标轴平面是它的三面墙。<bookmark mark='b'/>它有六个顶点。<bookmark mark='c'/>目标函数的等值集，也就是利润相同的点，是一族平行的平面。<bookmark mark='d'/>沿利润增加的方向推动这个平面，直到它即将离开多面体。它最后碰到的点是一个顶点：第一种产品两个单位、第三种一个单位，利润为十三。<bookmark mark='e'/>情况总是如此：多面体上的线性函数在某个顶点取到最大值，所以只有有限个地方需要查看。难处在于，高维的多面体可以有天文数字般多的顶点。

1894ce9caf7a.en: Dantzig's simplex method walks from corner to corner. <bookmark mark='a'/> Start at a vertex; the origin, making nothing at all, is one. <bookmark mark='b'/> From the current vertex, look along the edges that leave it. Is any of them uphill, increasing the profit? <bookmark mark='c'/> If so, move along it until you hit the next vertex. Here the walk goes from zero profit to twelve and a half, making only the first product, and then to thirteen. <bookmark mark='d'/> When no edge goes uphill, you are done. That is the subtle part: a local check proves a global optimum, because in a convex region a vertex with no improving edge cannot be beaten anywhere. <bookmark mark='e'/> Here it took two moves.
1894ce9caf7a.zh: Dantzig 的单纯形法从一个顶点走到另一个顶点。<bookmark mark='a'/>从某个顶点出发；原点，什么都不生产，就是一个顶点。<bookmark mark='b'/>在当前顶点，查看从它出发的各条边。有没有哪条是上坡的，能增加利润？<bookmark mark='c'/>如果有，就沿它走，直到碰到下一个顶点。这里，路径从零利润走到十二点五，只生产第一种产品，然后到十三。<bookmark mark='d'/>当没有上坡的边时，就完成了。微妙之处在于：一个局部检查证明了全局最优，因为在凸区域中，没有改进边的顶点在任何地方都无法被超越。<bookmark mark='e'/>这里走了两步。

f52dc89fda6b.en: In algebra, the walk is a sequence of pivots. <bookmark mark='a'/> Add a slack variable to each inequality, the unused amount of each resource, and the constraints become equations. The slacks themselves form the first basis: the origin, where all resources are unused. <bookmark mark='b'/> The bottom row holds the objective. A negative entry means increasing that variable raises the profit; Dantzig's rule picks the most negative, here the first product. <bookmark mark='c'/> How far can it rise? The ratio test divides each right-hand side by the column's entry and takes the smallest: the first resource runs out first, at two and a half. <bookmark mark='d'/> The pivot is one step of Gaussian elimination, making that column a unit vector. <bookmark mark='e'/> One more pivot brings in the third product, and now the bottom row has no negative entries. The profit is thirteen, and the numbers under the slack columns, one, zero and one, are the prices of the resources, which the next chapter shows are a proof.
f52dc89fda6b.zh: 在代数上，这条路径是一连串的转轴。<bookmark mark='a'/>给每个不等式添一个松弛变量，即每种资源未用掉的数量，约束就变成了等式。松弛变量本身构成第一个基：原点，所有资源都未使用。<bookmark mark='b'/>最下面一行是目标函数。负的元素意味着增加那个变量会提高利润；Dantzig 规则选最负的那个，这里是第一种产品。<bookmark mark='c'/>它能增加多少？比值检验把每个右端项除以该列的元素，取最小者：第一种资源最先用完，在二点五处。<bookmark mark='d'/>转轴就是高斯消元的一步，把这一列变成单位向量。<bookmark mark='e'/>再一次转轴引入第三种产品，现在最下面一行没有负元素了。利润是十三，而松弛变量各列下面的数，一、零、一，是各资源的价格；下一章会说明，它们就是一个证明。

dfa8ceae5741.en: Which edge should the walk take? <bookmark mark='a'/> Dantzig's rule takes the steepest coefficient. <bookmark mark='b'/> At degenerate vertices, where more constraints are tight than the dimension needs, a pivot can change the basis without moving, and with an unlucky rule the method can cycle through the same bases forever. <bookmark mark='c'/> Robert Bland's rule, from 1977, always picks the smallest eligible index, and provably never cycles. <bookmark mark='d'/> Production solvers use smarter rules, like steepest edge, and keep the tableau implicit, as an LU factorization of the basis, updated after each pivot. <bookmark mark='e'/> The simplex method was named one of the ten most important algorithms of the twentieth century. Whether some pivot rule always finishes in polynomially many steps is still unknown, and chapter four shows why that question is subtle.
dfa8ceae5741.zh: 路径应该走哪条边？<bookmark mark='a'/>Dantzig 规则取最陡的系数。<bookmark mark='b'/>在退化顶点处，紧约束比维数所需的更多，一次转轴可能改变了基却没有移动；规则选得不巧，方法会在同样的几个基之间永远循环。<bookmark mark='c'/>Robert Bland 1977年的规则总是选下标最小的可选变量，可以证明它永不循环。<bookmark mark='d'/>工业级求解器使用更聪明的规则，比如最陡边规则，并且不显式保存单纯形表，而是把它表示为基的 LU 分解，每次转轴后更新。<bookmark mark='e'/>单纯形法被评为二十世纪最重要的十个算法之一。是否存在某种转轴规则总能在多项式步内结束，至今仍不知道；第4章会说明为什么这个问题很微妙。

656bd4072669.en: How could anyone prove that thirteen is the best possible profit? <bookmark mark='a'/> Multiply each constraint by a non-negative number and add them up. <bookmark mark='b'/> If the combined left side has at least the objective's coefficients, five, four and three, then for any feasible plan the profit is at most the combined right side. <bookmark mark='c'/> Three times the first constraint gives six, nine and three, which covers five, four and three, so the profit is at most fifteen. Five thirds of the third constraint proves thirteen and a third. Five quarters of the second fails: it doesn't cover the coefficients of the second and third products. And one of the first plus one of the third proves exactly thirteen. <bookmark mark='d'/> Finding the best bound is itself a linear program, the dual: minimize five y one plus eleven y two plus eight y three, subject to the covering conditions.
656bd4072669.zh: 怎样才能证明十三就是可能的最大利润？<bookmark mark='a'/>把每个约束乘以一个非负数，再加起来。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果合并后的左边至少达到目标函数的系数五、四、三，那么对任何可行的计划，利润都不超过合并后的右边。<bookmark mark='c'/>第一个约束乘以三得到六、九、三，覆盖了五、四、三，所以利润至多为十五。第三个约束乘以三分之五，证明利润至多十三又三分之一。第二个约束乘以四分之五则不行：它覆盖不了第二、第三种产品的系数。而第一个约束加上第三个约束，恰好证明了十三。<bookmark mark='d'/>寻找最好的界，本身就是一个线性规划，即对偶问题：在覆盖条件下，最小化五 y 一加十一 y 二加八 y 三。

3af21bc32ade.en: So every linear program has a twin. <bookmark mark='a'/> The primal maximizes over x; the dual minimizes over y, with the matrix transposed and the roles of b and c exchanged. <bookmark mark='b'/> Weak duality is the argument we just made: every feasible plan earns at most every feasible bound. <bookmark mark='c'/> Strong duality says more: at the optimum they are equal, so the best bound is always tight. John von Neumann saw it in 1947, in a conversation with Dantzig, and Gale, Kuhn and Tucker proved it in 1951. <bookmark mark='d'/> The engine of the proof is Farkas' lemma, from 1902: a system of linear equations either has a non-negative solution, or there is a short certificate that it doesn't, and never both. <bookmark mark='e'/> Geometrically, a point outside a convex cone can always be separated from it by a hyperplane. <bookmark mark='f'/> The practical meaning is that every optimum comes with a proof a sceptic can check with one multiplication of a matrix by a vector.
3af21bc32ade.zh: 所以每个线性规划都有一个孪生兄弟。<bookmark mark='a'/>原始问题对 x 求最大，对偶问题对 y 求最小，矩阵被转置，b 和 c 的角色互换。<bookmark mark='b'/>弱对偶就是我们刚才的论证：每个可行计划的收益都不超过每个可行的界。<bookmark mark='c'/>强对偶说得更多：在最优处两者相等，所以最好的界总是紧的。John von Neumann 在1947年与 Dantzig 的一次谈话中看出了这一点，Gale、Kuhn 和 Tucker 在1951年证明了它。<bookmark mark='d'/>证明的引擎是1902年的 Farkas 引理：一个线性方程组要么有非负解，要么有一个简短的证书说明它没有，二者绝不同时成立。<bookmark mark='e'/>从几何上看，凸锥之外的点总能用一个超平面与它分开。<bookmark mark='f'/>它的实际意义是：每个最优解都附带一个证明，怀疑者只需做一次矩阵乘向量就能检验。

e071048798e0.en: The dual variables mean something. <bookmark mark='a'/> The optimal y i is the shadow price of resource i: how much the best profit would rise with one more unit of it. <bookmark mark='b'/> It is a local price. We added one unit of the first resource and re-solved: the profit rose by a third, not by one, because the extra unit changed which constraints were tight. <bookmark mark='c'/> Complementary slackness ties the two programs together: a resource that is not used up has price zero, and a product whose resources are worth more than its profit is not made. <bookmark mark='d'/> Here the second resource has a unit to spare, so its price is zero, and the second product would cost three more in resources than it earns, so the optimum doesn't make it. <bookmark mark='e'/> Every solver reports these prices, and economists read them as the prices a competitive market would set.
e071048798e0.zh: 对偶变量是有含义的。<bookmark mark='a'/>最优的 y i 是资源 i 的影子价格：多一个单位的这种资源，最大利润会增加多少。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是一个局部的价格。我们给第一种资源加一个单位再重新求解：利润增加了三分之一，而不是一，因为多出的这一单位改变了哪些约束是紧的。<bookmark mark='c'/>互补松弛把两个规划联系在一起：没有用完的资源价格为零；所耗资源的价值高于其利润的产品不会被生产。<bookmark mark='d'/>这里第二种资源还剩一个单位，所以它的价格为零；第二种产品所耗资源的价值比它的利润多三，所以最优解不生产它。<bookmark mark='e'/>每个求解器都会报告这些价格，经济学家把它们解读为竞争市场会定出的价格。

64389dab41fd.en: Chapter four. Exponential in theory, fast in practice.
64389dab41fd.zh: 第4章。理论上是指数的，实践中却很快。

5724fd39d079.en: How many pivots can the simplex method need? <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1972 Victor Klee and George Minty built a bad example: a cube, squashed so that it is no longer square. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each coordinate's bounds depend a little on the coordinate before it, which tilts every face slightly. <bookmark mark='c'/> On this cube, Dantzig's rule visits every vertex before reaching the top, climbing at every step. In n dimensions that is two to the n vertices. <bookmark mark='d'/> Here in three dimensions: seven pivots, through all eight corners.
5724fd39d079.zh: 单纯形法最多可能需要多少次转轴？<bookmark mark='a'/>1972年，Victor Klee 和 George Minty 构造了一个坏例子：一个被压扁、不再方正的立方体。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个坐标的上下界都稍稍依赖于前一个坐标，这使得每个面都略微倾斜。<bookmark mark='c'/>在这个立方体上，Dantzig 规则在到达顶端之前会访问每一个顶点，每一步都在上升。在 n 维中，那是二的 n 次方个顶点。<bookmark mark='d'/>这里是三维：七次转轴，经过全部八个顶点。

e487af793fb9.en: We ran our simplex on Klee–Minty cubes up to twelve dimensions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Dantzig's rule takes exactly two to the n minus one pivots, every time: four thousand and ninety-five at twelve. <bookmark mark='b'/> Bland's rule does better on this cube but is exponential on its own variants, as David Avis and Chvátal showed. <bookmark mark='c'/> The greatest-improvement rule, which tries every edge and takes the one that gains most, solves this cube in one pivot; Robert Jeroslow built cubes in 1973 that defeat it too. <bookmark mark='d'/> The pattern repeated for decades: almost every pivot rule proposed has acquired its own bad example, the last famous one, Zadeh's rule, in 2011. <bookmark mark='e'/> No pivot rule is known to run in polynomial time.
e487af793fb9.zh: 我们在最高十二维的 Klee–Minty 立方体上运行了自己的单纯形法。<bookmark mark='a'/>Dantzig 规则每次都恰好需要二的 n 次方减一次转轴：十二维时是四千零九十五次。<bookmark mark='b'/>Bland 规则在这个立方体上表现好一些，但在它自己的变体上同样是指数的，David Avis 和 Chvátal 证明了这一点。<bookmark mark='c'/>最大改进规则试遍每条边、取增益最大的那条，它一次转轴就解决了这个立方体；Robert Jeroslow 在1973年构造了也能打败它的立方体。<bookmark mark='d'/>这种模式重复了几十年：几乎每一个被提出的转轴规则都有了自己的坏例子，最后一个著名的是2011年的 Zadeh 规则。<bookmark mark='e'/>还没有任何已知的转轴规则能在多项式时间内运行。

72b1ca558a46.en: Yet the simplex method is fast on real problems, usually a small multiple of the number of constraints. Why? <bookmark mark='a'/> On random dense programs our simplex took under half as many pivots as there are constraints: thirty-four on average for a hundred and sixty. <bookmark mark='b'/> Daniel Spielman and Shang-Hua Teng explained it in 2001 with smoothed analysis: take any linear program, even the worst, and add a little Gaussian noise to its data. The expected number of pivots is then polynomial in the size and in one over the size of the noise. <bookmark mark='c'/> The bad instances are knife-edge constructions. Shake them and they fall over. On our ten-dimensional cube, tiny noise changes nothing, but noise of ten percent cuts the thousand and twenty-three pivots to about four hundred, and thirty percent to about seventy-five. <bookmark mark='d'/> They won the Gödel Prize for it, and smoothed analysis now explains why other algorithms that are bad in the worst case work in practice.
72b1ca558a46.zh: 然而单纯形法在实际问题上很快，通常只需要约束数的一个小倍数。为什么？<bookmark mark='a'/>在随机的稠密规划上，我们的单纯形法用的转轴次数还不到约束数的一半：一百六十个约束平均三十四次。<bookmark mark='b'/>Daniel Spielman 和滕尚华在2001年用平滑分析解释了这一点：取任何一个线性规划，哪怕是最坏的，给它的数据加上一点高斯噪声。那么转轴次数的期望就是规模以及噪声大小倒数的多项式。<bookmark mark='c'/>坏实例是刀锋上的构造，摇一摇它们就倒了。在我们的十维立方体上，极小的噪声什么也改变不了，但百分之十的噪声把一千零二十三次转轴减到大约四百次，百分之三十则减到大约七十五次。<bookmark mark='d'/>他们因此获得了哥德尔奖，平滑分析如今还解释了为什么其他一些最坏情况下很差的算法在实践中却管用。

5dddb3b52668.en: Chapter five. Polynomial time: ellipsoids and the central path.
5dddb3b52668.zh: 第5章。多项式时间：椭球与中心路径。

2e479cb86a5d.en: In 1979 Leonid Khachiyan proved that linear programs can be solved in polynomial time, by a method that walks no edges at all. <bookmark mark='a'/> Ask instead whether a polytope is empty. Start with a ball large enough to contain it. <bookmark mark='b'/> Look at the ball's centre. If it is feasible, you're done. If not, some constraint is violated there, and that constraint says the polytope lies entirely on one side of a line through the centre. <bookmark mark='c'/> Replace the half that remains by the smallest ellipsoid that contains it, and repeat. <bookmark mark='d'/> Each step shrinks the volume by a fixed factor, e to the minus one over two n plus two, so after polynomially many steps the ellipsoid is smaller than any non-empty polytope with these numbers could be. <bookmark mark='e'/> Here, nine cuts reach a feasible point. Optimization reduces to feasibility by binary search on the objective, or by adding the objective as one more cut.
2e479cb86a5d.zh: 1979年，Leonid Khachiyan 证明了线性规划可以在多项式时间内求解，用的方法根本不沿边行走。<bookmark mark='a'/>换个问法：多面体是不是空的？从一个大到足以包含它的球开始。<bookmark mark='b'/>看球心。如果它可行，就完成了。如果不可行，那里就有某个约束被违反，而这个约束说明多面体整个位于过球心的某条直线的一侧。<bookmark mark='c'/>用包含剩下那一半的最小椭球代替它，然后重复。<bookmark mark='d'/>每一步都把体积缩小一个固定的倍数，e 的负二 n 加二分之一次方，所以经过多项式步之后，椭球会比用这些数据构成的任何非空多面体都小。<bookmark mark='e'/>这里，九次切割就到达了一个可行点。优化问题可以通过对目标值二分查找，或者把目标函数作为又一个切割加进去，归结为可行性问题。

024affb3df18.en: How many steps? <bookmark mark='a'/> As the feasible region gets thinner, the number of cuts grows with the logarithm of one over its width: in two dimensions, about seventeen more for every factor of ten, on average. <bookmark mark='b'/> In general the bound is n squared times the number of bits in the input, polynomial, and the New York Times reported it on its front page. <bookmark mark='c'/> In practice the method is far slower than simplex, and nobody solves linear programs with it. <bookmark mark='d'/> Its legacy is a theorem. Martin Grötschel, László Lovász and Alexander Schrijver showed that the method never needs the constraints written down, only a way to find a violated one. So a linear program with exponentially many constraints is still solvable in polynomial time, if violated constraints can be found efficiently. Separation is as easy as optimization.
024affb3df18.zh: 需要多少步？<bookmark mark='a'/>可行域越薄，切割次数就随它宽度倒数的对数增长：在二维中，宽度每缩小十倍，平均多大约十七次。<bookmark mark='b'/>一般地，界是 n 的平方乘以输入的位数，是多项式的，《纽约时报》把它登上了头版。<bookmark mark='c'/>在实践中，这个方法比单纯形法慢得多，没有人用它求解线性规划。<bookmark mark='d'/>它留下的遗产是一个定理。Martin Grötschel、László Lovász 和 Alexander Schrijver 证明，这个方法从不需要把约束写出来，只需要一种找出被违反约束的办法。所以，即使一个线性规划有指数多个约束，只要能高效地找到被违反的约束，它仍然可以在多项式时间内求解。分离和优化一样容易。

2c98e3d55569.en: The method that made polynomial time practical came in 1984 from Narendra Karmarkar at Bell Labs. <bookmark mark='a'/> Instead of walking along the boundary, stay strictly inside. <bookmark mark='b'/> Add to the objective a barrier, the sum of the logarithms of the slacks, which rises to infinity at every wall, and weight the true objective by a parameter t. <bookmark mark='c'/> For each t there is one best point, and as t grows these points trace a smooth curve, the central path, from the middle of the polytope to the optimal vertex. <bookmark mark='d'/> Follow it: increase t a little, take a few steps of Newton's method to get back to the path, and repeat. The distance from optimal is at most the number of constraints divided by t. <bookmark mark='e'/> The theory promises the square root of m times the log of one over the accuracy; in practice it takes twenty to eighty Newton steps whatever the size. <bookmark mark='f'/> It is Newton's method from the AI series, and every serious solver runs it alongside simplex.
2c98e3d55569.zh: 让多项式时间变得实用的方法，1984年来自贝尔实验室的 Narendra Karmarkar。<bookmark mark='a'/>不沿着边界走，而是严格地待在内部。<bookmark mark='b'/>给目标函数加上一个障碍项，即各松弛量的对数之和，它在每面墙上都趋于无穷，并用参数 t 给真正的目标函数加权。<bookmark mark='c'/>对每个 t 都有一个最优点；随着 t 增大，这些点描出一条光滑的曲线，即中心路径，从多面体的中间通向最优顶点。<bookmark mark='d'/>沿着它走：把 t 增大一点，用几步牛顿法回到路径上，然后重复。与最优值的差距至多是约束数除以 t。<bookmark mark='e'/>理论上保证的是 m 的平方根乘以精度倒数的对数；实践中，无论规模多大，都只需要二十到八十步牛顿迭代。<bookmark mark='f'/>这正是 AI 系列中的牛顿法，每个严肃的求解器都把它和单纯形法一起运行。

227583189520.en: Chapter six. When the vertices are integers.
227583189520.zh: 第6章。当顶点都是整数时。

757faf05ea5c.en: Most integer programs are hard, but some are linear programs in disguise. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take bipartite matching from Part 18. Give each edge a variable between zero and one, and require that the edges at each vertex sum to at most one. <bookmark mark='b'/> The constraint matrix has a column for each edge, with a one at each of its ends: the incidence matrix. <bookmark mark='c'/> For a bipartite graph it is totally unimodular: every square submatrix has determinant zero, one or minus one. We checked every one of this matrix's square submatrices. <bookmark mark='d'/> Then by Cramer's rule every vertex of the polytope has integer coordinates, because each coordinate is a ratio of determinants and the denominator is plus or minus one. <bookmark mark='e'/> So the simplex method, which ends at a vertex, solves the integer problem for free. On a hundred random weighted bipartite graphs, not one optimal vertex had a fractional coordinate.
757faf05ea5c.zh: 大多数整数规划都很难，但有些其实是伪装起来的线性规划。<bookmark mark='a'/>以第18部分的二分图匹配为例。给每条边一个介于零和一之间的变量，并要求每个顶点处各边之和至多为一。<bookmark mark='b'/>约束矩阵每条边一列，在它的两个端点处各有一个一：这就是关联矩阵。<bookmark mark='c'/>对二分图，它是全单模的：每个方子矩阵的行列式都是零、一或负一。我们检查了这个矩阵的每一个方子矩阵。<bookmark mark='d'/>于是由克莱姆法则，多面体的每个顶点都有整数坐标，因为每个坐标都是行列式之比，而分母是正负一。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以终止于顶点的单纯形法，免费地解决了整数问题。在一百个随机赋权的二分图上，没有一个最优顶点有分数坐标。

ccb3a91228ad.en: Outside bipartite graphs it fails, and the smallest failure is a triangle. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its incidence matrix has determinant two. <bookmark mark='b'/> The linear program happily puts one half on each edge, for a total of one and a half, though any matching in a triangle has just one edge. <bookmark mark='c'/> On a hundred random weighted graphs that were not bipartite, a quarter of the optimal vertices were fractional. <bookmark mark='d'/> Jack Edmonds repaired it in 1965: add a constraint for every odd set of vertices, saying it contains at most half as many edges, rounded down, and the polytope is integral again. <bookmark mark='e'/> There are exponentially many such constraints, but a violated one can be found quickly, so by chapter five's theorem the program is still solvable in polynomial time.
ccb3a91228ad.zh: 离开二分图它就失效了，最小的反例是一个三角形。<bookmark mark='a'/>它的关联矩阵行列式为二。<bookmark mark='b'/>线性规划乐于在每条边上放二分之一，总共一点五，尽管三角形中任何匹配都只有一条边。<bookmark mark='c'/>在一百个随机赋权的非二分图上，四分之一的最优顶点是分数的。<bookmark mark='d'/>Jack Edmonds 在1965年修补了它：为每个奇数大小的顶点集添一个约束，说它内部至多含有其一半、向下取整那么多条边，多面体就又是整的了。<bookmark mark='e'/>这样的约束有指数多个，但被违反的约束可以很快找到，所以由第5章的定理，这个规划仍然可以在多项式时间内求解。

e36c5fa179d2.en: The same miracle explains other results we already know. <bookmark mark='a'/> Maximum flow is a linear program whose matrix, a directed incidence matrix, is totally unimodular. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its dual is minimum cut, so Part 18's max-flow min-cut theorem is linear programming duality in disguise. <bookmark mark='c'/> And integer capacities always admit an integer maximum flow, as Ford and Fulkerson's augmenting paths found. <bookmark mark='d'/> Interval matrices, which arise in scheduling, and network matrices are totally unimodular too. <bookmark mark='e'/> Paul Seymour proved in 1980 that every totally unimodular matrix is assembled from network matrices and two small exceptions, so whether a matrix has the property can be tested in polynomial time.
e36c5fa179d2.zh: 同样的奇迹解释了我们已经知道的其他结果。<bookmark mark='a'/>最大流是一个线性规划，它的矩阵是有向关联矩阵，是全单模的。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的对偶是最小割，所以第18部分的最大流最小割定理，就是伪装起来的线性规划对偶。<bookmark mark='c'/>而整数容量总有整数的最大流，正如 Ford 和 Fulkerson 的增广路径所找到的那样。<bookmark mark='d'/>调度中出现的区间矩阵，以及网络矩阵，也都是全单模的。<bookmark mark='e'/>Paul Seymour 在1980年证明，每个全单模矩阵都是由网络矩阵和两个小的例外拼装而成的，所以一个矩阵是否具有这种性质，可以在多项式时间内检验。

42757ddb059a.en: Insist that the answer be made of whole things, and linear programming becomes NP-hard. The standard attack keeps linear programming as a guide. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is a knapsack: eight items with values and weights, and a capacity of eighty. Relax it: let items be taken fractionally. That linear program is easy, greedy by value per unit of weight, and its optimum bounds what any whole choice can reach. <bookmark mark='b'/> The root's bound is a hundred and eighty-four, with one item taken in part. Branch on that item: one subproblem takes it, the other leaves it out, and each has its own bound. <bookmark mark='c'/> Any node whose bound cannot beat the best whole answer found so far is pruned without being explored. <bookmark mark='d'/> Here the best answer, a hundred and seventy-four, is found and proved optimal after twenty-four nodes, instead of the two hundred and fifty-six possible choices. Ailsa Land and Alison Doig invented the method in 1960, at the London School of Economics.
42757ddb059a.zh: 坚持答案必须由整个的东西组成，线性规划就变成了 NP 难的。标准的攻法仍以线性规划为向导。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是一个背包问题：八件物品，各有价值和重量，容量为八十。把它松弛：允许物品按分数取。这个线性规划很容易，按单位重量的价值贪心即可，它的最优值给出任何整数选择所能达到的上界。<bookmark mark='b'/>根节点的界是一百八十四，有一件物品只取了一部分。在这件物品上分支：一个子问题取它，另一个不取，各有自己的界。<bookmark mark='c'/>任何一个界不能超过迄今最好整数解的节点，都不经探索就被剪掉。<bookmark mark='d'/>这里，最好的答案一百七十四在二十四个节点之后被找到并被证明最优，而不是检查全部二百五十六种可能的选择。Ailsa Land 和 Alison Doig 于1960年在伦敦政治经济学院发明了这个方法。

84e831006491.en: How well does it scale? <bookmark mark='a'/> On random knapsacks of up to a hundred and sixty items, where there are two to the hundred and sixty choices, branch and bound needed a few hundred nodes on average, because the linear bound was within a percent or two of the truth. Bad instances exist, but the bound does most of the work. <bookmark mark='b'/> Ralph Gomory showed in 1958 how to cut instead of branch: derive a new inequality that every whole solution satisfies but the fractional optimum violates, add it, and solve again. <bookmark mark='c'/> Modern solvers do both, branch and cut, with layers of presolving and heuristics. <bookmark mark='d'/> Robert Bixby measured their progress: between 1991 and 2007 the algorithms alone became about thirty thousand times faster, on top of the hardware. <bookmark mark='e'/> They schedule airline crews, run power grids, match kidney donors and place components on chips.
84e831006491.zh: 它的扩展性如何？<bookmark mark='a'/>在最多一百六十件物品、有二的一百六十次方种选择的随机背包上，分支定界平均只需要几百个节点，因为线性界与真值相差不过百分之一二。坏实例是存在的，但界承担了大部分工作。<bookmark mark='b'/>Ralph Gomory 在1958年展示了如何用切割代替分支：推导出一个新的不等式，每个整数解都满足它，而分数最优解违反它；把它加进去，再求解。<bookmark mark='c'/>现代求解器两者都做，即分支切割，再加上层层的预处理和启发式方法。<bookmark mark='d'/>Robert Bixby 度量过它们的进步：1991年到2007年间，仅算法本身就快了大约三万倍，这还没算硬件的提升。<bookmark mark='e'/>它们为航空公司排机组，调度电网，匹配肾脏捐献者，在芯片上布置元件。

06c6f358fcea.en: Knapsack also shows a different kind of compromise. <bookmark mark='a'/> Part 19 solved it exactly by dynamic programming, in time proportional to the capacity, which can be astronomically large. <bookmark mark='b'/> Oscar Ibarra and Chul Kim rounded every value down to a multiple of epsilon times the largest value, divided by n, and solved the rounded problem exactly, by dynamic programming over values. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each item loses less than one rounding unit, so the whole answer loses at most epsilon times the best value, and the table has n squared over epsilon entries. Any accuracy you like, in time polynomial in n and one over epsilon: a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme. <bookmark mark='d'/> On a hard, strongly correlated instance, even epsilon of nine tenths, which promises only a tenth of the optimum, found ninety-nine point three percent; from a tenth down, it found the exact optimum, and the work grew only in proportion to one over epsilon.
06c6f358fcea.zh: 背包问题还展示了另一种妥协。<bookmark mark='a'/>第19部分用动态规划精确地解决了它，时间与容量成正比，而容量可以大得惊人。<bookmark mark='b'/>Oscar Ibarra 和 Chul Kim 把每个价值向下取整到 epsilon 乘以最大价值再除以 n 的倍数，然后对价值做动态规划，精确地求解取整后的问题。<bookmark mark='c'/>每件物品损失不到一个取整单位，所以整个答案至多损失 epsilon 乘以最优值，而表格有 n 的平方除以 epsilon 个元素。任意你想要的精度，时间是 n 和 epsilon 倒数的多项式：一个完全多项式时间近似方案。<bookmark mark='d'/>在一个困难的强相关实例上，即使 epsilon 取十分之九，只保证最优值的十分之一，它也找到了百分之九十九点三；从十分之一往下，它找到的就是精确最优解，而工作量只与 epsilon 的倒数成正比地增长。

00b31aec4812.en: When the exact answer is out of reach, ask for an answer provably close to it. <bookmark mark='a'/> A vertex cover is a set of vertices touching every edge, and finding the smallest one is NP-hard. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here is a two-line algorithm. Take any edge whose ends are both uncovered and add both ends. Repeat until every edge is covered. <bookmark mark='c'/> The edges it took share no vertex, and any cover at all must contain at least one end of each of them, so the optimum is at least half of what we took. That is a factor two guarantee, proved without knowing the optimum. <bookmark mark='d'/> Here it takes eight vertices, against an optimum of six. <bookmark mark='e'/> The second way uses the linear program: give each vertex a fraction, require each edge's two fractions to sum to at least one, and minimize the total. Then keep every vertex whose fraction is at least a half. <bookmark mark='f'/> The relaxation's vertices only take the values zero, a half and one. Here it puts a half everywhere, four and a half in all, a lower bound on the optimum, and rounding keeps all nine. Again at most twice the linear program, so at most twice the optimum.
00b31aec4812.zh: 当精确答案遥不可及时，就要一个可证明与它接近的答案。<bookmark mark='a'/>顶点覆盖是一组触及每条边的顶点，找出最小的那组是 NP 难的。<bookmark mark='b'/>这里有一个两行的算法。取任意一条两端都未被覆盖的边，把两端都加进来。重复，直到每条边都被覆盖。<bookmark mark='c'/>它取的这些边两两没有公共顶点，而任何覆盖都必须至少包含其中每条边的一端，所以最优解至少是我们所取的一半。这就是一个二倍的保证，而且不需要知道最优解就证明了。<bookmark mark='d'/>这里它取了八个顶点，而最优是六个。<bookmark mark='e'/>第二种办法用线性规划：给每个顶点一个分数，要求每条边两端的分数之和至少为一，并最小化总和。然后保留分数至少为二分之一的每个顶点。<bookmark mark='f'/>松弛问题的顶点只取零、二分之一和一这几个值。这里它处处取二分之一，总共四点五，这是最优解的一个下界，而取整保留了全部九个顶点。同样至多是线性规划值的两倍，所以至多是最优解的两倍。

a4f7d3033d34.en: We ran both on a hundred random graphs with sixteen vertices, against the exact optimum found by brute force. <bookmark mark='a'/> Both stay comfortably inside their guarantee of two, though both are tight on other graphs. <bookmark mark='b'/> Nobody knows how to do better than two minus a vanishing amount, and Subhash Khot and Oded Regev showed that if the Unique Games Conjecture is true, nobody can. <bookmark mark='c'/> The linear program cannot help further either: on a complete graph its value is n over two, while the optimum is n minus one, an integrality gap of two.
a4f7d3033d34.zh: 我们在一百个十六个顶点的随机图上运行了这两种算法，并与暴力搜索得到的精确最优解比较。<bookmark mark='a'/>两者都稳稳地落在二倍的保证之内，尽管在别的图上两者都是紧的。<bookmark mark='b'/>没有人知道如何做得比二减去一个趋于零的量更好；Subhash Khot 和 Oded Regev 证明了，如果唯一博弈猜想成立，就没有人能做到。<bookmark mark='c'/>线性规划也帮不上更多的忙：在完全图上，它的值是 n 的一半，而最优解是 n 减一，整性间隙为二。

40e809b8364e.en: Set cover is the general form: cover a universe of elements with as few of the given sets as possible. <bookmark mark='a'/> The greedy algorithm repeatedly takes the set that covers the most elements not yet covered. <bookmark mark='b'/> David Johnson and László Lovász proved in the 1970s that greedy uses at most the n-th harmonic number times the optimum, about the natural log of n. <bookmark mark='c'/> The proof spreads the cost of each chosen set over the elements it newly covers, and shows that the elements of any one optimal set pay at most H n in total. <bookmark mark='d'/> The bound is nearly tight. In this trap two rows cover everything, but greedy is lured by columns of sizes doubling down, and takes seven sets where two suffice. <bookmark mark='e'/> On random instances it was within six percent on average. And Uriel Feige proved that doing better than the logarithm is hard, so greedy, the first thing anyone would try, is essentially the best possible.
40e809b8364e.zh: 集合覆盖是一般形式：用尽可能少的给定集合覆盖一个元素全集。<bookmark mark='a'/>贪心算法反复选取覆盖最多尚未覆盖元素的那个集合。<bookmark mark='b'/>David Johnson 和 László Lovász 在1970年代证明，贪心所用的集合数至多是第 n 个调和数乘以最优值，大约是 n 的自然对数。<bookmark mark='c'/>证明把每个选中集合的代价分摊到它新覆盖的元素上，并说明任何一个最优集合中的元素总共至多支付 H n。<bookmark mark='d'/>这个界几乎是紧的。在这个陷阱里，两行就覆盖了一切，但贪心被大小逐次减半的各列引诱，用了七个集合，而两个就够了。<bookmark mark='e'/>在随机实例上，它平均只差百分之六。Uriel Feige 证明了，做得比对数更好是困难的，所以任何人都会先试的贪心，本质上已经是最好的了。

caac6abb9ca6.en: The travelling salesman wants the shortest tour through all the cities. <bookmark mark='a'/> In general no approximation factor at all is possible: give the missing roads of a graph enormous lengths, and any algorithm that was within a factor c would tell you whether the graph has a Hamiltonian cycle. <bookmark mark='b'/> So assume real distances, which obey the triangle inequality: going straight is never longer than a detour. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then here is a factor two. The minimum spanning tree is no longer than the best tour, because removing one edge of the tour leaves a spanning tree. Walk around the tree, using every edge twice, and skip cities you have already visited. <bookmark mark='d'/> Nicos Christofides, and independently Anatoliy Serdyukov, did better in 1976. The tree's odd-degree vertices can be paired up by a matching at most half the optimum. Add it, and every degree is even, so there is an Euler tour; shortcut it. <bookmark mark='e'/> At most three halves of the optimum. <bookmark mark='f'/> And here is the optimum itself, from Held and Karp's dynamic program.
caac6abb9ca6.zh: 旅行商想要一条经过所有城市的最短回路。<bookmark mark='a'/>一般情况下，任何近似因子都不可能：给图中不存在的道路赋上巨大的长度，那么任何能做到 c 倍以内的算法，都会告诉你这个图有没有哈密顿回路。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以假定真实的距离，它们满足三角不等式：直走永远不比绕路长。<bookmark mark='c'/>这样就有了一个二倍的算法。最小生成树不比最优回路长，因为从回路中去掉一条边就剩下一棵生成树。绕着树走一圈，每条边走两次，跳过已经访问过的城市。<bookmark mark='d'/>Nicos Christofides，以及独立地 Anatoliy Serdyukov，在1976年做得更好。树中奇数度的顶点可以用一个至多为最优值一半的匹配配成对。把它加进来，每个顶点的度都成了偶数，于是有一条欧拉回路；再走捷径。<bookmark mark='e'/>至多是最优值的二分之三。<bookmark mark='f'/>而这就是最优回路本身，来自 Held 和 Karp 的动态规划。

06081123b29f.en: How do they do in general? We ran them on forty random instances of twelve cities, against the exact optimum. <bookmark mark='a'/> The double tree averaged twenty-one percent above optimal, and Christofides seven percent. But the best performer has no guarantee at all: nearest neighbour followed by two-opt, which keeps finding two edges whose swap shortens the tour, uncrossing them, until no swap helps. It averaged just over one percent above optimal. <bookmark mark='b'/> That gap between guarantee and practice runs through this whole chapter. <bookmark mark='c'/> For forty-five years nobody improved on three halves, until Anna Karlin, Nathan Klein and Shayan Oveis Gharan beat it in 2021 by ten to the minus thirty-six, a tiny number and a large conceptual step. <bookmark mark='d'/> For cities in the plane, Sanjeev Arora and Joseph Mitchell found an approximation scheme: within one plus epsilon, for any epsilon you choose.
06081123b29f.zh: 一般情况下它们表现如何？我们在四十个十二城市的随机实例上运行了它们，与精确最优解比较。<bookmark mark='a'/>双树平均比最优高百分之二十一，Christofides 高百分之七。但表现最好的方法根本没有保证：最近邻之后再做二交换，不断寻找交换后能缩短回路的两条边，把它们解开，直到没有交换能改进为止。它平均只比最优高百分之一多一点。<bookmark mark='b'/>保证与实践之间的这种差距贯穿了整整这一章。<bookmark mark='c'/>四十五年里没有人改进过二分之三，直到2021年，Anna Karlin、Nathan Klein 和 Shayan Oveis Gharan 把它改进了十的负三十六次方，一个极小的数，却是一大步概念上的进展。<bookmark mark='d'/>对于平面上的城市，Sanjeev Arora 和 Joseph Mitchell 找到了一个近似方案：对你选的任何 epsilon，都能做到一加 epsilon 倍以内。

92e6d4113daf.en: And at scale? <bookmark mark='a'/> The exact dynamic program for fifteen cities already takes a few tenths of a second in Python, and every extra city doubles it. <bookmark mark='b'/> For three hundred random cities, nearest neighbour builds a tour of length sixteen point two, and two-opt shortens it to thirteen point nine in a tenth of a second. <bookmark mark='c'/> The optimum for random points is close to zero point seven one two four times the square root of n, a theorem from 1959, which predicts about twelve point three here. Two-opt is twelve percent above that estimate, which ignores the boundary of the square, so its true gap is somewhat smaller. <bookmark mark='d'/> Lin–Kernighan moves, and Keld Helsgaun's implementation of them, get within a fraction of a percent. <bookmark mark='e'/> And the Concorde program, built on linear programming cuts like Gomory's, has proved optimal tours through eighty-five thousand nine hundred cities, the points of a circuit board. <bookmark mark='f'/> Its uses run from delivery vans to telescopes and genome maps.
92e6d4113daf.zh: 规模大了又如何？<bookmark mark='a'/>十五个城市的精确动态规划在 Python 中就已经要零点几秒，每多一个城市时间就翻倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>对三百个随机城市，最近邻构造出长度十六点二的回路，二交换在十分之一秒内把它缩短到十三点九。<bookmark mark='c'/>随机点的最优回路长度接近零点七一二四乘以 n 的平方根，这是1959年的一个定理，它在这里预测大约十二点三。二交换比这个估计高百分之十二，而这个估计忽略了正方形的边界，所以真实的差距要小一些。<bookmark mark='d'/>Lin–Kernighan 移动，以及 Keld Helsgaun 对它们的实现，能做到相差不到百分之一。<bookmark mark='e'/>而建立在 Gomory 那样的线性规划割平面之上的 Concorde 程序，已经证明了经过八万五千九百个城市的回路是最优的，这些城市是一块电路板上的点。<bookmark mark='f'/>它的用途从送货车一直延伸到望远镜和基因组图谱。

c77714ca2855.en: Chapter ten. A random hyperplane: MAX-CUT.
c77714ca2855.zh: 第10章。随机超平面：最大割。

21d39140fa13.en: Here is one of the most elegant algorithms in this course. <bookmark mark='a'/> MAX-CUT asks for a split of a graph's vertices into two sides that cuts as many edges as possible. It is NP-hard. <bookmark mark='b'/> Write each vertex's side as plus or minus one; an edge is cut when the product of its ends is minus one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Michel Goemans and David Williamson relaxed the signs to unit vectors, and rewarded each edge for how far apart its two vectors point. <bookmark mark='d'/> That is a semidefinite program, a cousin of linear programming that can be solved efficiently. The vectors of adjacent vertices spread apart over the sphere. <bookmark mark='e'/> For this graph of twelve vertices the relaxation is worth eighteen point three, a little above the true maximum of eighteen. <bookmark mark='f'/> Now cut the sphere with a random plane through its centre, and put the vertices on each side of the plane on each side of the cut.
21d39140fa13.zh: 这是本课程中最优美的算法之一。<bookmark mark='a'/>最大割问题要求把图的顶点分成两边，使被切断的边尽可能多。它是 NP 难的。<bookmark mark='b'/>把每个顶点所在的一边写成正一或负一；一条边被切断，当且仅当它两端的乘积是负一。<bookmark mark='c'/>Michel Goemans 和 David Williamson 把这些符号松弛为单位向量，并按每条边两端向量分开的程度给它奖励。<bookmark mark='d'/>这是一个半定规划，是线性规划的近亲，可以高效求解。相邻顶点的向量在球面上彼此散开。<bookmark mark='e'/>对这个十二个顶点的图，松弛问题的值是十八点三，比真正的最大值十八略高。<bookmark mark='f'/>现在用一个过球心的随机平面切开球面，把平面两侧的顶点分别放到割的两边。

932734a01806.en: Why is that good? <bookmark mark='a'/> Two vectors at angle theta are separated by a random plane with probability theta over pi: the plane's direction has to fall in the wedge between them. <bookmark mark='b'/> Compare that with what the relaxation credited the edge, one minus cos theta over two. Their ratio is never less than about zero point eight seven eight. <bookmark mark='c'/> The worst case is an angle of about a hundred and thirty-four degrees. <bookmark mark='d'/> So edge by edge, the expected cut is at least zero point eight seven eight times the relaxation, which is at least the optimum. <bookmark mark='e'/> Before 1995 the best known guarantee was one half, from putting every vertex on a random side.
932734a01806.zh: 为什么这样做好？<bookmark mark='a'/>夹角为 theta 的两个向量被随机平面分开的概率是 theta 除以 pi：平面的方向必须落在它们之间的楔形里。<bookmark mark='b'/>把这与松弛问题给这条边的奖励，即一减 cos theta 再除以二，相比较。它们的比值永远不小于大约零点八七八。<bookmark mark='c'/>最坏的情况是大约一百三十四度的夹角。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以逐条边来看，割的期望至少是松弛值的零点八七八倍，而松弛值至少是最优值。<bookmark mark='e'/>1995年之前，已知最好的保证是二分之一，来自把每个顶点随机放到一边。

e7a8767f675a.en: We tried it on thirty random graphs, against the true maximum found by checking every split. <bookmark mark='a'/> Random sides cut about two thirds of the maximum. One random hyperplane averaged ninety-six percent, and its worst graph ninety-four, comfortably above the guarantee; the best of two hundred hyperplanes found the optimum on every graph. We solved the semidefinite program the simple way, by gradient steps on unit vectors. <bookmark mark='b'/> And the constant is no accident. Subhash Khot and colleagues showed in 2004 that if the Unique Games Conjecture holds, nobody can beat zero point eight seven eight in polynomial time. <bookmark mark='c'/> Without the conjecture, Johan Håstad proved that beating sixteen seventeenths is NP-hard. <bookmark mark='d'/> Relax to geometry, then round at random: the template now runs through the whole field.
e7a8767f675a.zh: 我们在三十个随机图上试了它，与检查每种划分得到的真正最大值比较。<bookmark mark='a'/>随机分边大约切到最大值的三分之二。一个随机超平面平均达到百分之九十六，最差的图也有百分之九十四，远在保证之上；两百个超平面中最好的那个在每个图上都找到了最优解。我们用简单的办法求解半定规划：在单位向量上做梯度步。<bookmark mark='b'/>而这个常数并非偶然。Subhash Khot 和同事们在2004年证明，如果唯一博弈猜想成立，就没有人能在多项式时间内超过零点八七八。<bookmark mark='c'/>不依赖这个猜想，Johan Håstad 证明了超过十七分之十六是 NP 难的。<bookmark mark='d'/>先松弛为几何，再随机取整：这个模板如今贯穿了整个领域。

d0fcdf4b4c93.en: Chapter eleven. Online: deciding without the future.
d0fcdf4b4c93.zh: 第11章。在线：看不见未来的决策。

9615f067f6c6.en: So far every algorithm saw its whole input. Many real decisions are made before the future arrives. <bookmark mark='a'/> Skis cost ten to buy, or one a day to rent, and you don't know how many days of snow there will be. <bookmark mark='b'/> Judge a strategy by its competitive ratio: in the worst case, how much more it pays than someone who knew the future, who would rent for short seasons and buy at once for long ones. <bookmark mark='c'/> Rent for nine days, then buy. If the season is short you paid what the clairvoyant paid; if it is long you paid nineteen instead of ten. Never more than twice. <bookmark mark='d'/> No deterministic rule does better, because an adversary who knows your rule can end the season the day after you buy. <bookmark mark='e'/> But if you buy on a random day, with the right probabilities, the adversary cannot aim, and the expected ratio falls to e over e minus one, about one point five eight. Our simulation of that rule paid fifteen point four for long seasons, against ten.
9615f067f6c6.zh: 到目前为止，每个算法都看得到完整的输入。而许多真实的决定，是在未来到来之前做出的。<bookmark mark='a'/>雪板买一副要十，租一天要一，而你不知道会下几天雪。<bookmark mark='b'/>用竞争比来评判一个策略：在最坏情况下，它比一个知道未来的人多付多少；那个人在雪季短时会一直租，在雪季长时会立刻买。<bookmark mark='c'/>先租九天，再买。如果雪季短，你付的和先知一样；如果雪季长，你付了十九而不是十。永远不超过两倍。<bookmark mark='d'/>没有确定性规则能做得更好，因为知道你规则的对手可以让雪季恰好在你买下的那天结束。<bookmark mark='e'/>但如果你以合适的概率在随机的一天买，对手就无从瞄准，期望比值降到 e 除以 e 减一，大约一点五八。我们对这条规则的模拟，在长雪季里付了十五点四，而先知付十。

5de247bbd437.en: Caches face the same problem every nanosecond: when the cache is full and a new line arrives, which old one should go? <bookmark mark='a'/> We replayed the Job's memory trace from Part 9, a hundred and fifty-five thousand accesses to ninety-two distinct lines, through caches of eight to ninety-six lines, under several policies. <bookmark mark='b'/> Laszlo Belady showed in 1966 that the optimal policy evicts the line whose next use is furthest in the future. It is perfect, and impossible online, but it measures everyone else. <bookmark mark='c'/> Least recently used stays within a factor of about one and a fifth to seven of the clairvoyant here, and FIFO is close behind. <bookmark mark='d'/> Once the cache is large, the randomized policies win: the marking algorithm, which evicts a random page not used since the current phase began, and even plain random eviction. The Job sweeps through its tables in loops, and loops are exactly where LRU is weakest, as the next example shows.
5de247bbd437.zh: 缓存每一纳秒都面临同样的问题：缓存满了，又来了一个新的行，哪个旧的该走？<bookmark mark='a'/>我们把第9部分 Job 的内存访问轨迹，十五万五千次访问、九十二个不同的行，在八到九十六行的缓存上，按几种策略重放了一遍。<bookmark mark='b'/>Laszlo Belady 在1966年证明，最优策略是淘汰下一次使用离现在最远的那一行。它是完美的，却无法在线实现，但它可以用来衡量其他所有策略。<bookmark mark='c'/>最近最少使用在这里与先知相差大约一点二倍到七倍，先进先出紧随其后。<bookmark mark='d'/>一旦缓存变大，随机化策略就胜出了：标记算法随机淘汰一个自当前阶段开始以来未被使用的页，甚至纯粹的随机淘汰也胜过 LRU。Job 在循环中扫过它的表，而循环恰恰是 LRU 最薄弱的地方，下一个例子会说明这一点。

cfce6bb5308e.en: How bad can least recently used be? <bookmark mark='a'/> Use a cache of four pages and request five pages in a cycle. The page LRU evicts is always the very next one requested, so every request is a fault. <bookmark mark='b'/> The clairvoyant evicts the page needed furthest away and faults about once every four requests. <bookmark mark='c'/> Daniel Sleator and Robert Tarjan founded competitive analysis with this example in 1985: LRU and FIFO are k-competitive, and the same adversary forces every deterministic policy to fault on every request, so none does better. Randomized marking cannot be trapped like this and pays a logarithmic factor, two H k. <bookmark mark='d'/> Real programs are kinder than adversaries, which is why approximations of LRU run every cache from Part 9 to Part 32.
cfce6bb5308e.zh: 最近最少使用能有多糟？<bookmark mark='a'/>用一个四页的缓存，循环请求五个页。LRU 淘汰的页总是下一个就要请求的那一页，所以每次请求都缺页。<bookmark mark='b'/>先知淘汰最远才需要的那一页，大约每四次请求才缺页一次。<bookmark mark='c'/>Daniel Sleator 和 Robert Tarjan 在1985年用这个例子创立了竞争分析：LRU 和 FIFO 是 k-竞争的，而同样的对手能迫使每个确定性策略在每次请求时都缺页，所以没有哪个做得更好。随机化的标记算法不会这样落入陷阱，只付出一个对数因子，二倍的 H k。<bookmark mark='d'/>真实的程序比对手仁慈，这就是为什么从第9部分到第32部分，每一个缓存都运行着 LRU 的近似。

9c7f2a6d73bc.en: One algorithm keeps turning up in this part's last chapters, and in much of computer science. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each day, ten experts each predict, and you must act on their advice before seeing who was right. Keep a weight for each expert and follow one at random, in proportion to the weights. <bookmark mark='b'/> After each day, multiply the weight of every expert who was wrong by a factor a little below one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Here one expert is wrong forty-five percent of the time and the others half the time. Within a few hundred rounds the weights find it. <bookmark mark='d'/> Measure regret: how much worse you did than the single best expert, chosen with hindsight. <bookmark mark='e'/> For any sequence of losses whatsoever, even one chosen by an adversary, the regret is at most the square root of T over two times log n. <bookmark mark='f'/> Our measured regret stays under that bound, and the regret per round shrinks towards zero: in the long run you do as well as the best expert, without knowing which one it is.
9c7f2a6d73bc.zh: 有一个算法在这一部分的最后几章里反复出现，在计算机科学的许多地方也是如此。<bookmark mark='a'/>每天有十位专家各自做出预测，你必须在知道谁对之前就按他们的建议行动。给每位专家一个权重，按权重的比例随机跟随一位。<bookmark mark='b'/>每天结束后，把每位说错了的专家的权重乘以一个略小于一的因子。<bookmark mark='c'/>这里有一位专家百分之四十五的时间出错，其他人百分之五十。几百轮之内，权重就找到了它。<bookmark mark='d'/>用遗憾来衡量：你比事后挑出的那位最好的专家差多少。<bookmark mark='e'/>对任何损失序列，哪怕是对手挑选的，遗憾都至多是 T 除以二乘以 log n 的平方根。<bookmark mark='f'/>我们测得的遗憾始终在这个界之下，每轮的遗憾趋于零：从长远看，你做得和最好的专家一样好，却不需要知道是哪一位。

5fc7d89507c7.en: The proof is four lines, and it is worth seeing once. <bookmark mark='a'/> Watch the total weight. It starts at n, one per expert. <bookmark mark='b'/> At the end it is at least the weight of the best expert alone, which has been multiplied by e to the minus eta once for each of its losses. <bookmark mark='c'/> And in each round, when we follow an expert in proportion to the weights, the total weight shrinks by a factor of about e to the minus eta times our expected loss that round, with a small correction from Hoeffding's inequality. <bookmark mark='d'/> Chain the rounds together, and the two facts squeeze: our loss cannot be much more than the best expert's, or the weight would have fallen below the best expert's own. <bookmark mark='e'/> Take logarithms, choose eta to balance the two terms, and the regret is the square root of T over two times log n. <bookmark mark='f'/> It is a potential argument, like the amortized analyses of Parts 16 and 17, and the same pattern proves boosting and the minimax theorem.
5fc7d89507c7.zh: 证明只有四行，值得看一次。<bookmark mark='a'/>盯住总权重。它从 n 开始，每位专家一。<bookmark mark='b'/>到最后，它至少是最好的那位专家单独的权重，而那个权重每出一次错就被乘一次 e 的负 eta 次方。<bookmark mark='c'/>而在每一轮中，当我们按权重比例跟随专家时，总权重缩小的因子大约是 e 的负 eta 乘以这一轮我们的期望损失次方，外加 Hoeffding 不等式给出的一个小修正。<bookmark mark='d'/>把各轮串起来，两个事实就形成夹击：我们的损失不可能比最好专家的多太多，否则总权重就会跌到最好专家自己的权重之下。<bookmark mark='e'/>取对数，选择 eta 使两项平衡，遗憾就是 T 除以二乘以 log n 的平方根。<bookmark mark='f'/>这是一个势函数论证，就像第16和第17部分的均摊分析，同样的模式还证明了提升法和极小极大定理。

7e7a914352b9.en: The same few lines prove theorems. <bookmark mark='a'/> In a zero-sum game, let one player run multiplicative weights over its strategies while the other always plays its best response. <bookmark mark='b'/> The two players' average strategies converge to the value of the game, here zero point four eight four six, as the gap between what each can guarantee closes. That is von Neumann's minimax theorem, proved by running an algorithm, and it is linear programming duality again. <bookmark mark='c'/> Put the weights on training examples instead of experts and you get boosting, which the AI series built. <bookmark mark='d'/> Put them on the constraints of a linear program and you get fast approximate solvers for flows and packing problems. <bookmark mark='e'/> Sanjeev Arora, Elad Hazan and Satyen Kale surveyed it under the title: a meta-algorithm and its applications.
7e7a914352b9.zh: 同样的几行代码能证明定理。<bookmark mark='a'/>在一个零和博弈中，让一方对自己的策略运行乘性权重，另一方总是给出最佳应对。<bookmark mark='b'/>双方的平均策略收敛到博弈的值，这里是零点四八四六，双方各自能保证的值之间的差距随之闭合。这就是 von Neumann 的极小极大定理，用运行一个算法来证明，而它又一次是线性规划的对偶。<bookmark mark='c'/>把权重放在训练样本上而不是专家上，就得到了提升法，AI 系列构造过它。<bookmark mark='d'/>把权重放在线性规划的约束上，就得到了求解流和装箱类问题的快速近似算法。<bookmark mark='e'/>Sanjeev Arora、Elad Hazan 和 Satyen Kale 以这样的标题综述了它：一个元算法及其应用。

c68989750cec.en: Chapter thirteen. Convex optimization in a page.

d01149e5faaf.en: Linear programs are the simplest convex problems, and the interior-point method of chapter five already used the general tool. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is a smooth convex function of two variables, a log-sum-exp from Boyd and Vandenberghe's textbook, stretched so its valley is narrow. <bookmark mark='b'/> Gradient descent steps downhill, choosing each step's length by backtracking. <bookmark mark='c'/> In a narrow valley the downhill direction points mostly across the valley, not along it, so the path zigzags: forty steps to reach ten digits. <bookmark mark='d'/> Newton's method fits a quadratic to the function at the current point, using second derivatives, and jumps to that quadratic's minimum. <bookmark mark='e'/> Four steps. Near the optimum the number of correct digits doubles with every step. <bookmark mark='f'/> But each Newton step solves a linear system in the Hessian, which is hopeless with a billion variables, and that is why the gradient methods of the AI series train neural networks.
d01149e5faaf.zh: 线性规划是最简单的凸问题，而第5章的内点法已经用到了一般的工具。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是一个两变量的光滑凸函数，来自 Boyd 和 Vandenberghe 教科书中的对数和指数函数，被拉伸得山谷很窄。<bookmark mark='b'/>梯度下降沿下坡方向前进，用回溯法选择每一步的步长。<bookmark mark='c'/>在狭窄的山谷里，下坡方向主要横穿山谷，而不是沿着山谷，所以路径呈之字形：要四十步才达到十位精度。<bookmark mark='d'/>牛顿法利用二阶导数，在当前点用一个二次函数拟合原函数，然后跳到这个二次函数的最小点。<bookmark mark='e'/>四步。在最优点附近，正确的位数每一步都翻倍。<bookmark mark='f'/>但每一步牛顿法都要解一个以海森矩阵为系数的线性方程组，有十亿个变量时这毫无希望，这就是为什么 AI 系列中训练神经网络用的是梯度方法。

7c95be777e7d.en: Convex optimization fits on a page. <bookmark mark='a'/> Minimize a convex function over a convex set, and every local minimum is a global one, with a dual certificate to prove it. <bookmark mark='b'/> At the optimum the Karush–Kuhn–Tucker conditions hold: the gradient of the objective is balanced by a non-negative combination of the gradients of the tight constraints. <bookmark mark='c'/> Those multipliers are the shadow prices of chapter three, generalized. <bookmark mark='d'/> There is a ladder of problem classes: linear programs, convex quadratic programs, second-order cone programs, and semidefinite programs like chapter ten's. <bookmark mark='e'/> Yurii Nesterov and Arkadi Nemirovski showed that interior-point methods solve all of them to any accuracy in polynomial time. <bookmark mark='f'/> Without convexity, local minima are everywhere and the general problem is NP-hard, though neural networks are trained anyway, which is one of the AI series' puzzles. <bookmark mark='g'/> As Tyrrell Rockafellar put it, the great watershed in optimization is not between linear and non-linear, but between convex and non-convex.
7c95be777e7d.zh: 凸优化可以写在一页纸上。<bookmark mark='a'/>在凸集上最小化凸函数，每个局部最小值都是全局最小值，并有一个对偶证书来证明它。<bookmark mark='b'/>在最优点，Karush–Kuhn–Tucker 条件成立：目标函数的梯度被紧约束梯度的一个非负组合所平衡。<bookmark mark='c'/>这些乘子就是第3章的影子价格，推广了而已。<bookmark mark='d'/>问题类形成一个阶梯：线性规划、凸二次规划、二阶锥规划，以及像第10章那样的半定规划。<bookmark mark='e'/>Yurii Nesterov 和 Arkadi Nemirovski 证明，内点法能在多项式时间内把它们全都求解到任意精度。<bookmark mark='f'/>没有凸性，局部最小值就到处都是，一般问题是 NP 难的；尽管如此，神经网络照样被训练出来了，这是 AI 系列的谜题之一。<bookmark mark='g'/>正如 Tyrrell Rockafellar 所说，优化中的分水岭不在线性与非线性之间，而在凸与非凸之间。

5f9b2e7360d4.en: Chapter fourteen. Frontier: faster linear programs, the Hirsch question, and the unique games conjecture.
5f9b2e7360d4.zh: 第14章。前沿：更快的线性规划、Hirsch 问题，以及唯一博弈猜想。

56bb1caec024.en: The first front is speed. <bookmark mark='a'/> Karmarkar's method needed about n to the three and a half operations for a linear program with n variables. Pravin Vaidya brought it to n to the two and a half, with fewer steps and the observation that consecutive Newton steps barely change the matrix, so its inverse can be updated instead of recomputed. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2019 Michael Cohen, Yin Tat Lee and Zhao Song pushed the idea to its natural end: n to the omega, where omega, about two point three seven, is the exponent of matrix multiplication. Jan van den Brand made it deterministic a year later. Solving a linear program now costs about as much as multiplying two matrices, and the floor, just reading the input, is n squared. <bookmark mark='c'/> The same machinery produced the biggest algorithms result of the decade. In 2022, Li Chen, Rasmus Kyng, Yang Liu, Richard Peng, Maximilian Probst Gutenberg and Sushant Sachdeva solved maximum flow in almost linear time, m to the one plus a vanishing exponent. <bookmark mark='d'/> It is an interior-point method on Part 18's flow program, where each step changes the flow so little that clever dynamic data structures keep it up to date.
56bb1caec024.zh: 第一条战线是速度。<bookmark mark='a'/>对 n 个变量的线性规划，Karmarkar 的方法大约需要 n 的三点五次方次运算。Pravin Vaidya 把它降到 n 的二点五次方：步数更少，并且注意到相继的牛顿步几乎不改变矩阵，所以它的逆可以更新而不必重新计算。<bookmark mark='b'/>2019年，Michael Cohen、Yin Tat Lee 和 Zhao Song 把这个思路推到了自然的终点：n 的 omega 次方，其中 omega 约为二点三七，是矩阵乘法的指数。一年后，Jan van den Brand 把它变成了确定性的。如今求解一个线性规划，代价大约和两个矩阵相乘一样，而下限，仅仅读入输入，是 n 的平方。<bookmark mark='c'/>同样的工具催生了这十年最重要的算法成果。2022年，Li Chen、Rasmus Kyng、Yang Liu、Richard Peng、Maximilian Probst Gutenberg 和 Sushant Sachdeva 在几乎线性的时间内解决了最大流，m 的一加一个趋于零的指数次方。<bookmark mark='d'/>它是作用在第18部分流规划上的内点法，每一步对流的改变都非常小，巧妙的动态数据结构就能让它保持最新。

c06f99df1d8d.en: The second front is the simplex method's own question. Could there be a pivot rule that always takes polynomially many steps? <bookmark mark='a'/> Then every polytope would have to have a short path between any two vertices. Here is one with twenty-four random facets and forty-four vertices; its two farthest vertices are eight edges apart. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 1957 Warren Hirsch conjectured that the distance is never more than the number of facets minus the dimension. <bookmark mark='c'/> On random polytopes it holds easily: the diameter grows roughly like the square root of the number of facets, far below the bound. <bookmark mark='d'/> But in 2010 Francisco Santos built a counterexample, a polytope in forty-three dimensions with eighty-six facets whose diameter is at least forty-four. <bookmark mark='e'/> The best upper bound known is not even polynomial: Gil Kalai and Daniel Kleitman's n to the log d plus two. <bookmark mark='f'/> Whether the diameter is bounded by some polynomial, the polynomial Hirsch conjecture, is open, and until it is settled nobody can hope to prove a simplex rule polynomial.
c06f99df1d8d.zh: 第二条战线是单纯形法自己的问题。会不会有一个转轴规则总在多项式步内结束？<bookmark mark='a'/>那样的话，每个多面体的任意两个顶点之间都必须有一条短路径。这是一个有二十四个随机面、四十四个顶点的多面体；它相距最远的两个顶点相隔八条边。<bookmark mark='b'/>1957年，Warren Hirsch 猜想这个距离永远不超过面数减去维数。<bookmark mark='c'/>在随机多面体上，它轻松成立：直径大致随面数的平方根增长，远低于这个界。<bookmark mark='d'/>但在2010年，Francisco Santos 构造了一个反例：一个四十三维、八十六个面的多面体，直径至少为四十四。<bookmark mark='e'/>已知最好的上界甚至不是多项式的：Gil Kalai 和 Daniel Kleitman 的 n 的 log d 加二次方。<bookmark mark='f'/>直径是否以某个多项式为界，即多项式 Hirsch 猜想，仍未解决；在它解决之前，没有人能指望证明某个单纯形规则是多项式的。

e812bf90da70.en: The third front is the other side of approximation: proving that nothing does better. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here are this part's problems, with the best known algorithm and the thresholds below which approximation is known to be hard. <bookmark mark='b'/> The tool is the PCP theorem of 1992: any proof can be rewritten so that a verifier checking a few random bits catches any error with good probability. <bookmark mark='c'/> It turns approximation into decision: getting closer than a threshold would solve an NP-complete problem. Johan Håstad showed that for MAX-3SAT the trivial seven-eighths is exactly right. Part 27 builds the theorem. <bookmark mark='d'/> For the other problems there are gaps, and in 2002 Subhash Khot proposed the unique games conjecture. If it is true, vertex cover cannot beat two and MAX-CUT cannot beat Goemans and Williamson's zero point eight seven eight, so both algorithms in this part are optimal. In 2018 Khot, Dor Minzer and Muli Safra proved a weaker cousin, the two-to-two theorem, which already makes vertex cover hard below the square root of two. <bookmark mark='e'/> And Prasad Raghavendra showed that if the conjecture holds, one semidefinite program is the best possible algorithm for every constraint satisfaction problem at once.
e812bf90da70.zh: 第三条战线是近似的另一面：证明没有什么能做得更好。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是这一部分的问题，列出了已知最好的算法，以及低于它就已知很难近似的阈值。<bookmark mark='b'/>工具是1992年的 PCP 定理：任何证明都可以改写成这样，只检查随机几位的验证者，就能以很大的概率抓住任何错误。<bookmark mark='c'/>它把近似变成了判定：近似得比某个阈值更好，就能解决一个 NP 完全问题。Johan Håstad 证明，对 MAX-3SAT，平凡的八分之七恰恰就是对的。第27部分会构造这个定理。<bookmark mark='d'/>对其他问题还有差距；2002年，Subhash Khot 提出了唯一博弈猜想。如果它成立，顶点覆盖就无法超过二，最大割无法超过 Goemans 和 Williamson 的零点八七八，所以这一部分的这两个算法都是最优的。2018年，Khot、Dor Minzer 和 Muli Safra 证明了一个较弱的近亲，二对二定理，它已经让顶点覆盖在二的平方根以下变得困难。<bookmark mark='e'/>而 Prasad Raghavendra 证明，如果这个猜想成立，一个半定规划就同时是每一个约束满足问题的最佳可能算法。

99c16ff65ade.en: Here is where things stand. <bookmark mark='a'/> Is there a strongly polynomial algorithm for linear programming, one whose number of steps depends only on the numbers of variables and constraints, not on how many bits the coefficients have? Max flow has one; general linear programming does not, and Steve Smale listed the question among his problems for this century. <bookmark mark='b'/> Is the diameter of every polytope bounded by a polynomial? <bookmark mark='c'/> And is the unique games conjecture true? <bookmark mark='d'/> This part's research problem takes the second.
99c16ff65ade.zh: 现状如下。<bookmark mark='a'/>线性规划有没有强多项式算法，即步数只依赖于变量数和约束数、而不依赖于系数有多少位？最大流有一个；一般的线性规划没有，Steve Smale 把这个问题列入了他为本世纪提出的问题之中。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个多面体的直径都以一个多项式为界吗？<bookmark mark='c'/>唯一博弈猜想是真的吗？<bookmark mark='d'/>这一部分的研究题选的是第二个。

5968804cc221.en: What we built in this part. Linear programs, and the simplex method walking the edges of a polytope. Duality, which turns every optimum into a certificate a sceptic can check. The Klee–Minty cube, which makes the walk exponential, and smoothed analysis, which explains why it never is in practice. The ellipsoid and the central path. Total unimodularity, which makes some integer programs free, and branch and bound for the rest. Approximation with proofs: covers, tours, knapsacks, and a random hyperplane through a sphere of vectors. And decisions without the future: ski rental, paging, and multiplicative weights.
5968804cc221.zh: 这一部分我们构造了什么。线性规划，以及沿着多面体的边行走的单纯形法。对偶，它把每个最优解变成一份怀疑者可以检验的证书。让这条路径变成指数长的 Klee–Minty 立方体，以及解释它在实践中为何从不如此的平滑分析。椭球与中心路径。让某些整数规划免费可解的全单模性，以及处理其余问题的分支定界。有证明的近似：覆盖、回路、背包，以及穿过一个向量球面的随机超平面。还有看不见未来的决策：租雪板、页面置换和乘性权重。

e39dca7529d5.en: Where this comes back. Part 27 builds the PCP theorem behind this part's hardness results, and the unique games conjecture. Part 32's kernel replaces pages with CLOCK, a cheap approximation of least recently used. Part 45's cloud packs virtual machines onto servers, an integer program solved by heuristics every second, and Part 48 balances load online. Part 52 explains why linear programming solvers fight floating point. And Part 57 turns multiplicative weights into a theory of learning. The AI series used this part's tools throughout: gradient descent and Newton's method, boosting, and the convex losses that make training tractable.
e39dca7529d5.zh: 它们会在哪里再出现。第27部分构造这一部分困难性结果背后的 PCP 定理，以及唯一博弈猜想。第32部分的内核用 CLOCK 置换页面，它是最近最少使用的一种廉价近似。第45部分的云把虚拟机装到服务器上，这是一个每秒都在用启发式方法求解的整数规划；第48部分在线地做负载均衡。第52部分解释为什么线性规划求解器要与浮点数搏斗。第57部分则把乘性权重变成一套学习理论。AI 系列自始至终都在使用这一部分的工具：梯度下降和牛顿法、提升法，以及让训练变得可行的凸损失函数。

737cb8841c2f.en: In practice. HiGHS, Gurobi, CPLEX and OR-Tools run simplex, barrier and branch and cut on problems with millions of variables. Airlines schedule crews, carriers route vehicles, and supply chains plan with integer programs. Power grids and kidney exchanges are cleared by optimization, with dual prices. Every cache makes online decisions, and every model is trained by the descendants of gradient descent.
737cb8841c2f.zh: 在实践中。HiGHS、Gurobi、CPLEX 和 OR-Tools 在有数百万变量的问题上运行单纯形法、障碍法和分支切割。航空公司排班机组，承运商规划车辆路线，供应链用整数规划做计划。电网和肾脏交换由优化来出清，并给出对偶价格。每个缓存都在做在线决策，而每个模型都由梯度下降的后代训练出来。

43a95b058ce3.en: Six problems, with full solutions in the part's notes. Pause on any of them. The fifth is a build problem: the simplex method in the Pebble language, with exact fractions, run on the emulator. The last, marked with a star, is a research problem: its answer is not known, and the notes say where to start.
43a95b058ce3.zh: 六道习题，完整解答在这一部分的笔记里。可以在任何一道上暂停。第五道是构造题：用 Pebble 语言、以精确分数实现单纯形法，在模拟器上运行。最后一道标有星号，是研究题：它的答案尚不知道，笔记里说明了从哪里入手。

87038a891033.en: Next time, algorithms in practice. Big-O hides constants, and in production the constants and the machine decide. The everyday tools of real code: prefix sums, Fenwick and segment trees, two pointers, monotonic stacks and bit tricks. Then algorithm engineering, where a textbook hash table or binary search becomes many times faster by respecting the caches, branch predictors and vector units of Act Two, and how to measure that honestly. Part 24, Algorithms in Practice.
87038a891033.zh: 下一次，实践中的算法。大 O 隐藏了常数，而在生产环境里，决定一切的是常数和机器。真实代码中的日常工具：前缀和、Fenwick 树和线段树、双指针、单调栈和位运算技巧。然后是算法工程：一个教科书式的哈希表或二分查找，只要尊重第二幕讲过的缓存、分支预测器和向量单元，就能快上许多倍，以及如何诚实地测量这一点。第24部分，实践中的算法。

9bd24692775d.en: The books and papers this part follows are on screen and in the notes. Thank you for watching.
9bd24692775d.zh: 这一部分所依据的书和论文都在屏幕上，也在笔记里。感谢观看。
